outputs: UI nhật ký/ảnh/nghiệm thu/lỗi/dòng tiền và hoàn công theo contract A
24 hồ sơ duyệt ảnh, ca UI/end-to-end/xuất và lỗi mạng
Xác minh website sau triển khai, phối hợp rollback khi lỗi

sharedPolicy: Unlisted existing files require a recorded owner before editing. A owns build/dependencies/integration; B supplies requested changes through progress handoff. Root task/scope/AGENTS edits are coordinated, never silently replace progress.
dependencyPolicy: Dependencies are shared deliverable milestones: development may use agreed mocks; mark ready only with the real dependent contract/fixture. B6 can validate A6's integration preview before A6 production release; G6 requires both signoffs.
ownerResolution: Resolve exact file owner first, then the longest matching prefix, then suffix defaults; conflicting owners at the same precedence are invalid. Existing unlisted files need an owner recorded before editing.

handoffReadiness.B2: Editor/persistence/resolved furniture adapter and current 2D/3D pose parity; full BOQ parity is G4, not a prerequisite for B2 handoff.
handoffReadiness.A3: Measured drawings/exports and real geometry/furniture contract ready for B3; final B3 model parity is G3, not a prerequisite for A3 handoff.
handoffReadiness.A6: Integrated preview/dossier/supervision data ready for B6; production release requires B6 signoff at G6.
